meta.subject: fix wrong csc image data read jump control

en.summary: Fixes CSC image-data read-jump control so the extra lookahead read is not incorrectly triggered across stripe boundaries.
why_it_counts: The patch changes RTL control logic in the NVDLA CSC data loader.
It fixes when the design performs an extra simultaneous read for mid-entry image alignment.
The diff comments describe a concrete wrong-trigger condition tied to next-stripe execution.
evidence: NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v adds delayed stripe-end flops is_stripe_end_d1 and is_stripe_end_d2.
sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_enable now requires sc2buf_dat_rd_en_w and blocks the jump when is_stripe_end_d2 is asserted.
The old logic lacked stripe-end suppression and instead compared against dat_req_addr_last as part of the trigger.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Some convolution/image loaders issue an extra lookahead read when the current pixel group starts in the middle of a buffer entry and the next buffer entry is also needed. That lookahead must be restricted to discontinuities within the current stripe. If a stripe transition is mistaken for the same kind of intra-stripe address jump, the loader performs an unnecessary extra read and shifts data as if the next stripe belonged to the current one.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The image fetch path is near a stripe boundary while also evaluating whether an extra next-entry read is needed for alignment.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove the delayed stripe-end fence or current-read qualification from the lookahead-read enable condition so stripe transitions can trigger the jump path.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop stripe-boundary suppression on lookahead read
portability_notes: Apply this where a loader can request two adjacent buffer entries to assemble one aligned output window.
The key bug is confusing an inter-stripe address change with a same-stripe alignment jump.
The exact fence signal may need to be delayed by one or more cycles to match the pipeline stage that decides the extra read.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the predicate that enables an extra next-entry read for misaligned image data.
Remove the term that suppresses this path at stripe end, or stop qualifying it with the actual current-read enable.
Keep the shift/assembly logic intact so the failure is caused by an unnecessary extra read across a stripe transition.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CSC sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_enable control near stripe boundaries
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds delayed stripe-end state and updates sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_enable so the read-jump path only runs on real image reads and is blocked across stripe transitions.
repository_grounding.mutation_strategy: drop stripe-boundary suppression on lookahead read
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_enable, remove the ~is_stripe_end_d2 guard and/or replace sc2buf_dat_rd_en_w with the older looser trigger.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The loader issues an unnecessary extra read at a stripe boundary and shifts data incorrectly, producing wrong image data presented to later CSC stages.
evidence_for_injection: The patch adds explicit delayed stripe-end state solely to guard the jump-read path.
The accompanying comment says the address jump should not happen because of execution of the next stripe.
The change is localized to the extra-read enable predicate, which matches the stated bug mechanism.
notes: This bug should be validated with image cases that cross stripe boundaries and require partial-entry alignment.
The delayed stripe-end signals are an implementation detail; the portable mechanism is the missing stripe-transition fence.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 CSC 图像数据 read-jump 控制，使额外的前瞻读取不会在 stripe 边界上被错误触发。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 NVDLA CSC 数据加载器中的 RTL 控制逻辑。
它修复了设计在处理中间 entry 对齐时，何时需要额外并行读取下一 entry 的判断。
补丁注释明确说明了一个与 next-stripe execution 相关的错误触发条件。
evidence: NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v 新增了延迟后的 stripe-end 寄存器 is_stripe_end_d1 和 is_stripe_end_d2。
sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_enable 现在要求 sc2buf_dat_rd_en_w 为真，并在 is_stripe_end_d2 置位时禁止 jump。
旧逻辑缺少 stripe-end 抑制，而是把对 dat_req_addr_last 的比较作为触发条件的一部分。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 某些卷积/图像加载器会在当前像素组从 buffer entry 中间开始、且还需要下一 entry 数据时，发起一次额外的前瞻读取。这种前瞻必须只在当前 stripe 内部的地址不连续场景下触发。如果把 stripe 切换错误地当成同类的条内地址跳变，加载器就会发起不必要的额外读取，并像处理当前 stripe 一样去移位拼接下一 stripe 的数据。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 带 stripe 感知的前瞻 read-jump 控制
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 图像取数路径位于 stripe 边界附近，同时又在判断是否需要为对齐而额外读取下一 entry。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 从前瞻读取使能条件中移除延迟后的 stripe-end 屏蔽项，或移除对当前真实读取使能的限定，使 stripe 切换也能触发 jump 路径。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop stripe-boundary suppression on lookahead read
portability_notes: 适用于能够请求相邻两个 buffer entry 来拼装一个对齐输出窗口的加载器。
该缺陷的核心是把跨 stripe 的地址变化误判为同一 stripe 内的对齐跳变。
具体的屏蔽信号可能需要延迟一个或多个周期，以对齐到决定额外读取的流水级。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到为未对齐图像数据开启额外下一 entry 读取的谓词。
删除在 stripe 结束时抑制该路径的条件，或不再用当前真实读使能来约束它。
保持移位和拼接逻辑不变，使故障来源于跨 stripe 的不必要额外读取。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CSC 中 stripe 边界附近的 sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_enable 控制
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复新增了延迟的 stripe-end 状态，并更新 sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_enable，使 read-jump 路径只在真实图像读取时运行，且在跨 stripe 转换时被禁止。
repository_grounding.mutation_strategy: drop stripe-boundary suppression on lookahead read
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_enable 中移除 ~is_stripe_end_d2 保护，或把 sc2buf_dat_rd_en_w 恢复成旧的更宽松触发条件。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 加载器会在 stripe 边界发起不必要的额外读取，并错误移位数据，导致后续 CSC 阶段看到错误的图像数据。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁专门为 jump-read 路径新增了延迟后的 stripe-end 状态。
配套注释明确说 address jump 不应该因为执行 next stripe 而发生。
修改局限在额外读取使能谓词上，与所述缺陷机制完全一致。
notes: 验证时应使用跨越 stripe 边界且需要部分 entry 对齐的图像场景。
延迟 stripe-end 信号属于实现细节；可移植的核心机制是缺少对 stripe 转换的屏蔽。
